t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain coloured gnomes will lead me to a bright forest, the other colours will lead me to the dark forest. It is best for me to learn what colours lead to which forest to maximise my mushroom collecting

vb_textbox.text: I'm going to keep this short and sweet - only the colours matter, there are two groups of gnomes which lead to two different forests group one is orange, red, green and blue. Memorise it, if this group of colours isn't getting you a lot of mushrooms switch to the other colour group and you'll do fantastically :) Good luck!
